_floorException: FOUNDER DECISION OF RECORD, 2026-08-05. The clause text on the shipped card
renders at 26.0px against the 32px floor in asset spec §1.4, and at 23.4px on
the square. The founder accepted the shortfall rather than take a fourth
capture. It is recorded here rather than passed silently: the compositor
still measures it, still prints BELOW FLOOR and the exact shortfall on every
run, and still refuses any capture this record does not name.
WHY IT WAS ACCEPTABLE: the card is legible at the size it is actually seen —
the clause line lands near 10.8px at a 500px timeline render — and three
captures had already been taken. The floor is a quality bar, not a
WHAT WOULD MAKE THIS WRONG: a different capture. The exception is keyed to
this file's exact dimensions, so re-shooting invalidates it and the refusal
returns. Lowering `clauseFloorPx` in the script instead would waive the bar
for every future card, which is not what was decided.
